spans.s:
नि-गड (डः-डं) 1.
m. n. An iron chain
for the feet, a fetter.

निगडित (तः-ता-तं)
p. Chained.

नि-गण (णः) 1.
m. The smoke of a
burnt-offering, or sacrificial fire.

नि-गद (दः) 1.
m. Speech; recita-
tion of prayers or charms.

नि-गाद (दः) 1.
m. Speech.

नि-गदित (तः-ता-तं)
p. Spoken.
निगदितवत् (वान्-वती-वत्)
p. Speak-
ing or having spoken.

नि-गम (मः) 1.
m. A town; a mar-
ket; holy writ; a road; trade;
a caravan; certainty.

नि-गमन (नं) 1.
n. Going; conclusion.

नि-गर (रः) 1.
m. A swallow.

नि-गार (रः) 1.
m. Swallowing.

नि-गरण (णं) 1.
n. Eating.
m. The
throat; smoke of a burnt-offering.

नि-गाल (लः) 1.
m. Horse's throat.

निगाल-वत् (वान्) 5.
m. A horse.

नि-गीत (तः-ता-तं)
p. Sung.

नि-गु (गुः) 2.
m. The mind.

नि-गूढ (ढः-ढा-ढं)
a. Deep, obscure,
hidden.
m. A sort of wild bean.

नि-गूढा-र्थ (र्थः-र्था-र्थं)
a. Having a
hidden meaning or purpose.

नि-गूहनीय (यः-या-यं)
a. That should
be hid or protected.

नि-गृहीत (तः-ता-तं)
p. Seized; re-
strained; assailed, harassed.

नि-गृहीति (तिः) 2.
f. Restraint.

नि-ग्राह (हः) 1.
m. Curse.

नि-ग्रहण (णं) 1.
n. Disfavour; re-
straint; blame; limit.

निग्रह-स्थान (नं) 1.
n. Failure in lo-
gical argument.
